active.title: Validate model-based source cleanup
active.objective: Finish the checkpointed full-song pretrained cleanup experiment and accept/reject processing per source from RAW/CLEAN/REMOVED evidence.

live-soundcheck-v2: Studio-derived one-hypothesis live decision engine added
Masking action now requires measured overlap instead of legacy dominance heuristic
Live decision tests wired into CI and passed in workflow run 35833133811
studio-perceptual-v21: Perceptual Critic now has an explicit one-hypothesis candidate acceptance gate
Target-direction and collateral-regression tests added; focused perceptual tests passed 6/6
Artifact Critic was revised to be Nyquist-safe and to use a click-rate-specific regression tolerance
Full CI subsequently reached a separate editing-performance regression instead of the former Artifact Critic failure
studio-editing-small-sample: Full Tests run 35837914007 failed identically on Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 because robust_outliers disabled all passages shorter than eight events
Short-passage policy revised: six events can expose an extreme level defect; fewer than six remain diagnose-only
A 0.25 dB robust-scale floor prevents tiny low-variance performance differences from becoming false outliers
Regression coverage added for an obvious six-event defect, a stable six-event phrase, and a five-event diagnose-only phrase
Tests run 35840719646 progressed to a separate click_candidate regression: 295 passed, 1 skipped before failure on Python 3.11
studio-cleanup-checkpointing: Original sequential Ptitsa cleanup run 35828150231 reached the 180-minute workflow timeout and was cancelled before render/upload
Cleanup workflow refactored into 11 per-stem matrix jobs with max-parallel 6
Each completed stem now uploads a durable checkpoint: cleaned WAV, RAW/CLEAN/REMOVED MP3 previews and JSON residual metrics
Final full-mix render consumes the completed per-stem checkpoints instead of depending on one uninterrupted sequential job
Refactor commit 705b6f92c1bf202657e115ee330afcefd7fbddcb; replacement run 35846566268 started successfully

blockers.note: Six jobs can run concurrently; acceptance waits for per-stem RAW/CLEAN/REMOVED evidence.
click_candidates returned no candidate for the synthetic impulse fixture; not revised in the cleanup-checkpointing task.

history.note: Full multitrack download succeeded; neural cleanup was computing.
Studio-derived live decision engine tests are now part of CI and passed.
Added perceptual candidate acceptance and collateral regression guards.
Artifact Critic attempted a 6-14 kHz bandpass at 8 kHz sample rate and click-rate regression used an unsuitable generic 0.08 threshold.
Made Artifact Critic Nyquist-safe and click regression sensitivity metric-specific; later CI progressed to an editing-performance failure.
All three Python jobs stopped at test_editing_performance: a clearly defective sixth event was suppressed solely by the hard len<8 guard.
Lowered the evidence floor to six events and added regression coverage; subsequent CI reached test_click_candidate after 295 passing tests on Python 3.11.
The sequential CPU cleanup hit the workflow 180-minute limit. Final render, MP3 encoding and artifact upload were skipped, so no usable checkpoint survived.
Split 11 model-cleaned sources into independent matrix jobs (max-parallel 6), each producing cleaned WAV plus RAW/CLEAN/REMOVED previews and residual metrics before final mix assembly.
